/* A small arithmetic expression language, in W3C EBNF.
   Precedence is expressed by layering: Expr over Term over Factor. */

Expr   ::= Term ( ( "+" | "-" ) Term )*
Term   ::= Factor ( ( "*" | "/" ) Factor )*
Factor ::= NR | "(" Expr ")"

/* A JSON subset in W3C EBNF. `ST` and `NR` are the engine's built-in
   string and number lexer tokens, so this grammar is about structure
   rather than about re-deriving scalars character by character. */

Json   ::= Value
Value  ::= Object | Array | ST | NR | "true" | "false" | "null"
Object ::= "{" ( Member ( "," Member )* )? "}"
Member ::= ST ":" Value
Array  ::= "[" ( Value ( "," Value )* )? "]"

/* Character classes, in the style the XML specification uses them:
   an explicit start class, then a wider continuation class, with code
   points written in the #xNN form. */

Name      ::= NameStart NameChar*
NameStart ::= [A-Z] | "_" | [a-z] | [#xC0-#xD6]
NameChar  ::= NameStart | "-" | "." | [0-9] | #xB7
